63:t_1:172.en:
$$宗介$$
「I was told by $$千鳥$$ and $n that I'm not suited for it, and I've been benched.」

63:t_1:175.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The repairs on the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ are in sight, and from here $$マデューカス$$ and $$サックス$$ are taking command for me.」

63:t_1:176.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So, as things stand, I'm apparently relieved of duty.」

63:t_1:177.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... The Lieutenant Colonel and the others certainly don't mean that you're useless, Captain, or anything like that...」

63:t_1:178.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I know. I know everyone is working hard to get me to rest.」

63:t_1:179.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But... I'm anxious. If I'm not keeping myself moving...」

63:t_1:181.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We came to this $$翠の地球$$ to overthrow the $$新地球皇国$$, and yet we still haven't achieved anything...」

63:t_1:182.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sure that even at this very moment, $$蒼の地球$$ is under threat from the $$サイデリアル$$, and the $$レイライン$$ are extracting $$次元力$$, and yet...」

63:t_1:183.en:
$$テッサ$$
「As a commander, I can't do anything... I've tried to follow Captain $$ジェフリー$$'s example and keep a resolute attitude in front of my subordinates, but I don't know how long that will last...」

63:t_1:186.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If $$相良$$ were to say something kind to me now, I... I think I'd start crying...」

63:t_1:191.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I see... So I've got a pretty good idea what those 《$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$》 are now.」

63:t_1:192.en:
$$甲児$$
「Still, I'm surprised. To think you were fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ too, at the center of the galaxy.」

63:t_1:194.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I hear the $$フロンティア船団$$'s fold can't cover long distances either, because the dimensional boundary is unstable...」

63:t_1:195.en:
$n
「Even with hyperspace travel, it's not unlimited, huh...」

63:t_1:197.en:
$$甲児$$
「I couldn't quite follow how it came about, but that $$人類銀河同盟$$ was founded by descendants of Earthlings too, right?」

63:t_1:198.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't kno-w the de-tails my-self, though.」

63:t_1:199.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So that's why you speak Earth language. It's a little odd, though.」

63:t_1:202.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Could it be... you laughed?」

63:t_1:203.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah, yeah, that's a good sign.」

63:t_1:204.en:
$n
「He wasn't sullen after all. He just didn't know how to communicate.」

63:t_1:205.en:
$n
「In other words, he was the same as me.」

63:t_1:206.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You hold a grudge more than I expected, $n...」

63:t_1:207.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Anyway, as long as you have nowhere to go, you're a member of the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ too.」

63:t_1:209.en:
$$レド$$
「Wel-come? That is a word I do no-t know.」

63:t_1:210.en:
$$ティファ$$
「It means we are glad to have you here.」

63:t_1:212.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This isn't the middle of the galaxy, and the ones we fight aren't $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ either. You'll have to follow the way things are done here.」

63:t_1:213.en:
$$ガロード$$
「For starters, no more stunts like yesterday.」

63:t_1:214.en:
$$レド$$
「You mean that I tried to pur-sue the ene-my...?」

63:t_1:215.en:
$$甲児$$
「Right. They'd already lost the will to fight, too.」

63:t_1:216.en:
$$レド$$
「I only tried to e-liminate the ene-my.」

63:t_1:217.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Well... sure, those guys are the enemy. That doesn't mean we need to take lives for nothing.」

63:t_1:218.en:
$$レド$$
「...I do not un-der-stand what you are sa-ying...」

63:t_1:219.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This isn't a language problem. It seems to be a matter of ethics and norms...」

63:t_1:223.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$, this is the one who pulled you out of the sea.」

63:t_1:225.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「$$レド$$, was it? Thank you for helping the fleet yesterday.」

63:t_1:227.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「It's awkward to say this to someone who did us a favor, but here, killing is forbidden above all else.」

63:t_1:228.en:
$$レド$$
「...Bu-t you kill li-ving crea-tures and eat them.」

63:t_1:229.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Sure, we kill fish and birds and eat them. But even that's only as much as we need to live. We don't kill needlessly.」

63:t_1:230.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Much less pirates. They're people... our own kind. You can't take a life lightly.」

63:t_1:231.en:
$$レド$$
「What about the $$サイデリアル$$?」

63:t_1:232.en:
$$ガロード$$
「They're still human too, no matter what.」

63:t_1:233.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's a multiverse, after all. If we started saying someone isn't human because they're from a different star, there'd be no end to it.」

63:t_1:234.en:
$$レド$$
「...If you for-bid people from killing each other, wh-y do you keep wea-pons?」

63:t_1:235.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Setting $c aside, if we're talking about this fleet...」

63:t_1:236.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「If they want to, they can take your life too... The pirates use that threat to make people submit. So we show we won't just stand by and be killed either.」

63:t_1:237.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「As long as both sides are flaunting their cannons at each other, it's basically negotiation.」

63:t_1:238.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...We have a saying: 'Give fresh water to the one who brings back fish.'」

63:t_1:239.en:
$$レド$$
「A say-ing that en-courages mu-tual aid among people?」

63:t_1:240.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「That's right. We can't survive unless everyone brings what they have to share.」

63:t_1:241.en:
$$甲児$$
「So that's why the fleet helped us.」

63:t_1:242.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Yesterday, too, $c protected the fleet from the $$サイデリアル$$. We're all comrades now.」

63:t_1:245.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「No, it's nothing... That's for $$リジット$$ and the Fleet Commander to think about.」

63:t_1:247.en:
$$レド$$
「I un-der-stand your view. But the pirates and the $$サイデリアル$$ do no-t abide by tho-se rules.」

63:t_1:248.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Of course, we can't accept that. No way we'll hand our lives or our property over to pirates.」

63:t_1:249.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「But to do that, all it takes is letting them know that attacking us won't pay off.」

63:t_1:250.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「But when someone dies, it's a different story. To win back their standing, they have to shed even more blood, or they can't back down.」

63:t_1:253.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Even so, it's a fact that you fought to protect the fleet.」

63:t_1:254.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「We're grateful for that. Let me thank you again.」
